announcements.title: Estate Updates
announcements.desc: Latest news, advisories, and announcements from the estate.

onboarding.step1Body: This is your home dashboard. See today's weather, total supplied kg, earnings, and quick actions at a glance.
onboarding.step2Body: Record every fertilizer application, pruning, and plucking round. The smart advisory engine reads these to recommend your next steps.
onboarding.step3Body: Enter your plot details (acreage, bush count, GPS, photos) and divide it into blocks. Admin will approve, then your data auto-fills everywhere.
onboarding.step4Body: Fertilizer cycle due, pruning mixture reminder, weather guard — we send FCM pushes to your phone even when the app is closed.

supplierFert.title: My Fertilizer
supplierFert.desc: Track fertilizer received from factory (credit + cash) + your remaining balance. Settle credit balances at the factory finance office.
supplierFert.noLogs: Fertilizer log නොමැත · No fertilizer usage logged yet.
supplierFert.logHint: Log applications in 'My Farm Activities' → Fertilizer tab.
supplierFert.emptyMsg: No fertilizer received from factory yet.
supplierFert.emptyHint: When admin issues fertilizer to you (credit or cash), it will appear here. Make sure your supplier name matches what admin typed in the Inventory module.
supplierFert.how1: When admin issues fertilizer to you in the Inventory module, they pick 'Credit' + your supplier name.
supplierFert.how2: The issue appears here with the date, fertilizer type, and quantity.
supplierFert.how3: 'Used (kg)' is computed from your 'My Farm Activities' logs.
supplierFert.how5: Credit issues should be settled at the factory finance office.
supplierFert.syncNote: Real-time synced to Supabase `supplier_fertilizer_ledger` + `farm_activities` tables. Offline edits queue and sync when online.

supplierPlot.blocksHint: Divide your plot into blocks (e.g., Upper Block, Lower Block) to track per-section activities. Optional but recommended.

supplierTips.title: Tips & Guidance
supplierTips.desc: Daily agronomy tips to maximize your tea plot's yield. Bilingual (English + Sinhala). Personalized to your plot acreage if you've entered it in 'My Plot'.
supplierTips.yieldFromFertBody: Based on the fertilizer you've applied so far, you can expect approximately {{kg}} kg of green leaf over the next 30 days.
supplierTips.yieldFromFertDetail: Urea boosts vegetative growth (1 kg Urea ≈ 6 kg leaf); TSP/MOP sustain quality. Actual yield depends on weather, bush age, and plucking cycle.
supplierTips.potentialBody: For your {{acreage}} acres plot ({{region}} region), you could harvest up to {{kg}} kg green leaf per year (~{{monthly}} kg/month). Follow the tips below to reach this potential.
supplierTips.fertGuidanceHint: ඔබගේ {{acreage}} අක්කර වත්තට අවශ්‍ය පොහොර ප්‍රමාණය පහත පරිදි යෙදිය යුතුය. (Recommended fertilizer quantities for your plot.)

supplierWeather.title: My Weather
supplierWeather.desc: Live weather forecast for your plot's location. Plan fertilizer application around rain forecasts — rain within 3 days can wash away fertilizer.
supplierWeather.rainAlertBody: ⚠ Avoid applying fertilizer now — rainfall can wash it away before plants absorb it. Wait for a dry window (rain probability < 30%).

equipment.title: Equipment Requests
equipment.desc: Standalone module for requesting plucking machines, spray machines, bags, shears, and other field equipment.
equipment.notePh: e.g. Needed for the peak flush plucking round in Sutton division…
